title: Phenomenality as a transparent representation of subjective confidence

statements.text: If the analysis of minimal phenomenal experience is right, phenomenality is a transparent, temporally thin and global representation of subjective confidence relative to the abstract possibility of knowledge, an expectation of knowledge that, being transparent, creates the appearance that something knowable exists.

sources.quote: phenomenality is a transparent, temporally thin, and global representation of subjective confidence
More simply, we could say that MPE is an expectation of knowledge.
